items.description: navigating to /sku/:sku via <App> in <MemoryRouter> renders the SkuDetailPage at that route
given a SKU seeded at two unique per-run locations, GET the detail endpoint for that SKU returns one JSON object per location each carrying that location and its quantity
when a SKU has stock at multiple locations, the detail page renders one row per location carrying a data-testid='location-row'
each location row in the SKU detail page displays the location name
each location row in the SKU detail page displays the quantity on hand
given a SKU seeded at a unique per-run location with a combined tracking code, GET the detail endpoint for that SKU returns the combined tracking code for that location's stock record
each location row in the SKU detail page displays the combined tracking code in a data-testid='tracking-code' element
the tracking code element carries its design-guide class seam (asserted via data-testid='tracking-code', not via inline style)

given a SKU seeded at a unique per-run location with no tracked par level, GET the detail endpoint for that SKU returns an explicit not-tracked indicator rather than null or a blank value in the par level field
when par level is null, the detail page renders a data-testid='par-level-untracked' indicator instead of a blank region
the 'not tracked' par-level element carries its design-guide class seam (asserted via data-testid='par-level-untracked', not via inline style)
rendering <App> in <MemoryRouter initialEntries={["/sku/:sku"]}> does not crash when the API returns a null par level
